name: intraday-equities-multi3-h03-lgbm
notes: LightGBM on the three split-free tradables (JPM, LLY, XOM; AAPL and WMT are dropped - their raw Alpaca tape carries unadjusted splits, docs/research/unadjusted-stock-splits-in-the-raw-alpaca-tape.md), with the ADR-0059 label: residual to SPY, then divided by its own causal 390-minute sigma times sqrt(h). Both transforms answer A0040: squared loss on a raw return weights the open hour 5-10x the midday, and at 5-20 minutes most of a single name's variance is the market move the features cannot forecast. MSPE is now in LABEL units and is NOT comparable with any raw-label run; val_ic stays rank-based and is. Paired with run-multi3-h20-ridge.json, which differs ONLY in the scan node's estimator block (ADR-0060). hpo_trials stays 6, not the 32 of A0036: that search ranked 32 tree combos on an inner holdout whose score carried no information about fold validation, so the draws bought noise. Six draws over four knobs is a floor, not a search. HORIZON: this document asks about H=3 minute(s) ONLY - lead_start=lead_stop=3 (ADR-0062), so the training label and the single walked lead are both 1. The H=20 family trained at 5 and walked 5/10/15/20; these are a different question on the same cohort, folds and label, not a re-run. Run to resolve WHY H=1 rejected 40% of name-folds with a +0.09% MSPE gain while H=20/30/60 sat at the null with a negative one. Bid-ask bounce predicts the gain decays like 1/h (the label always contains px[t], but its variance grows with h), so ~+0.045% at H=2 and ~+0.03% at H=3. A gain that decays SLOWER than that is not bounce.

features.notes: lookback=20 emits one-minute ret_lag columns for the last 20 minutes. Every horizon here is cross_session so none costs rows beyond a one-time warmup; see docs/research/row-loss-is-intra-session-scale-warmup-not-cross-session.md.

tradable.notes: SPY has already entered the residual features; score tradables.

scan.notes: LightGBM with the symbol as a category, six inner-holdout draws over four knobs. Same label, same folds, same cohort as the ridge twin: the estimator block is the ONLY difference, so a gap between them is the model and nothing else. The grid is the single lead 1: h* is 1 or nothing, and the Clark-West p IS the test at that horizon.

names.notes: The three split-free tradables. Sits after tradable so the cohort that built the cross-sectional features (all five plus SPY) is untouched; only what gets SCORED narrows.

walkforward.notes: Same post-COVID folds as run-hstar-cv-postcovid.json so the two are comparable: first validation 2022-05-06, twenty 63-day steps, a real 730-day bounded training window, last validation inside the 2025-11-30 cut. objective is val_ic, NOT go_frac: counting fold-level rejections and taking the max is vote counting, which Hedges-Olkin showed is inconsistent when per-fold power is below one half (A0035). The winner here only labels a fold in the summary; the science is the per-fold sequence, which is what the block-by-block reading needs. embargo_days=5 is now larger than any label window on this grid (20 minutes), so no training row's label can reach into validation.
